candidates.status: source-level risk, not a reproduced bug
candidates.finding: DamageOtherLiving replaces the committed cursor with InstructionIndex-1 before BeginProgramSkillDamage. A first instruction can therefore leave cursor 0 while a real before/after-damage or dying child is suspended.
candidates.boundary: Executor commits cursor before handlers (SkillProgramExecutor.cs:1475); BeginProgramSkillDamage keeps the current rewound parent when attaching AttackAttempt. Every command checks all ProgramSkillFrame cursors >=1 (GameEngine.SkillPrograms.cs:1099). Synchronous damage that fully returns and reexecutes before commit can mask the risk; a child crossing a command boundary cannot rely on that.
candidates.coverage_gap: FrameOwnedBatchChecks exercises real children, replay, source loss and condition-change retirement, but deliberately puts a setMarkerAmount node before damageOtherLiving (batch cursor 2 or 3). The current ol:cuike and FengLinLuJi fixture also put another node first. No first-node child fixture found; descriptor does not require that prelude.
candidates.next_step: First add a focused first-node variant with a genuine child prompt and cold replay. Preserve existing condition-change/source-loss checks. Only after reproduction consider committed-cursor repeat state with exact typed continuation validation; do not relax the global cursor invariant.

candidates.boundary: LoseHp -> BeginProgramSkillDying pushes a DyingFrame and may expose a rescue or dying-entry child. Recovery/nonlethal loss, discard and draw branches do not use this rewind.
